events.zh_summary: Anthropic 发布 Anthropic Economic Index connector for Claude，用户可在 claude.ai 连接器目录中约一分钟内启用，无需安装，且适用于任意 Claude 模型和任意对话。它让用户直接用自然语言查询该指数数据，例如哪些职业使用 AI 最多、科罗拉多州用户最常用 Claude 做什么、教师用 Claude 处理哪些任务，以及过去一年自动化任务的变化。回答基于指数数据，并可回溯源数据与局限；文章强调该指数反映的是 Claude 使用模式，而不是整体劳动力市场。
events.full_zh:
人们对人工智能与工作有着迫切的疑问：哪些工作会发生变化，哪些任务正在被自动化，以及这对他们自己的领域意味着什么。Anthropic经济指数正是为了用真实数据帮助回答这些问题而存在。今天，我们为Claude推出Anthropic经济指数连接器，让任何人都能直接探索这些数据。

Anthropic经济指数衡量人工智能在经济中的实际使用情况。该指数的数据对研究人员、记者和政策制定者很有用，但我们希望它对任何好奇人工智能如何融入自己领域或日常生活的人也同样易于获取。现在，你可以向Claude提出这样的问题：

“哪些职业使用人工智能最多？”“科罗拉多州的人们最常用Claude做什么？”“教师用Claude完成哪些类型的任务？”“人们用人工智能自动化哪些类型的任务？过去一年这发生了怎样的变化？”

你将得到直接基于该指数数据的答案。

上手大约需要一分钟。在claude.ai中，打开连接器菜单，在目录中找到Anthropic经济指数并启用它——它在任何Claude模型的任何对话中都能使用，而且无需安装任何东西。然后，就像向同事提问一样发问：先问宽泛的问题（“该指数对我的行业是怎么说的？”），再深入具体细节，并让Claude向你展示任何答案背后的底层数据。

一如既往，该指数反映的是Claude使用中的模式，而非整个劳动力市场，并且Claude会在你探索时引导你回到源数据及其局限性。你今天就可以在claude.ai中找到该连接器，完整数据集仍可在我们的网站上免费获取。

events.zh_title: Snowflake 10.38 预览：新增 IPADDRESS 数据类型
events.zh_summary: Snowflake 发布 10.38 版本预览说明，计划于 2026 年 10 月 17 日至 21 日完成推送。该版本预览 IPADDRESS 数据类型，可用原生 128 位值存储 IPv4 或 IPv6 地址，并在插入或加载时校验、按规范形式存储、按数值地址顺序比较。预览包含 TO_IPADDRESS、TRY_TO_IPADDRESS 和 IPADDRESS_TRUNC 等函数，其中 IPADDRESS_TRUNC 可按前缀长度返回网络地址，用于按子网分组和匹配。
events.full_zh:
10.38 发行说明（预览）¶

注意

本页面内容在 10.38 版本发布完成之前即可获取。推广工作于 2026 年 10 月 17 日开始，计划于 2026 年 10 月 21 日完成（可能会变更）。

本页面所述的功能、更新或行为变更在版本发布完成之前可能无法在你的账户中使用。

有关这些发行说明的更新，请参阅 发行说明变更日志。

SQL 更新¶

IPADDRESS 数据类型（预览）¶

在此版本中，Snowflake 欣然宣布 IPADDRESS 数据类型进入预览阶段。一个 IPADDRESS 值以原生 128 位值的形式存储 IPv4 或 IPv6 地址。当你插入或加载地址时，Snowflake 会验证每个地址，以规范形式存储它，并按数值地址顺序比较值。因此，子网是一段连续的值范围，你可以使用 BETWEEN 对其执行筛选和联接。

该预览包含以下函数：

TO_IPADDRESS 和 TRY_TO_IPADDRESS 将字符串转换为 IPADDRESS 值。IPADDRESS_TRUNC 返回 IPADDRESS 值在给定前缀长度下的网络地址。可将其用于按子网对地址分组、屏蔽地址的主机位，以及将地址与以网络地址和前缀长度形式存储的网络进行匹配。

发行说明变更日志¶

公告更新日期发行说明首次发布（预览）2026 年 10 月 19 日

events.zh_title: Looker 26.18 将自动启用 Dremio 支持与 AI 工作流
events.zh_summary: 2026年10月5日起，运行 Looker 26.18 的 Looker（original）实例将自动启用多项功能，Looker（Google Cloud core）另行公布。新版本内置支持 Dremio 26.0+（Arrow Flight SQL）方言，使用捆绑的 Apache Arrow Flight SQL JDBC 驱动，无需安装未打包的自定义驱动 JAR。AI-Assisted Quick Starts（新 Explore 体验中的 Starter questions）正式可用；新增 Diagnose & Repair 工具，可通过八项诊断检查修复 LookML 项目仓库；CI 新增 Style Validator 以执行 LookML 编码规范。Conversational Analytics 的代理式工作流进入预览，支持按计划通过自然语言向邮件或 Slack 发送 AI 生成洞察摘要、数据表、可视化和 PDF 报告。
events.full_zh:
部署日期

公告

从 2026 年 10 月 5 日开始，以下功能将自动为运行 Looker 26.18 的 Looker（原始）实例启用。Looker（Google Cloud 核心）的功能启用将另行公告。

功能

Looker 现在内置支持 Dremio 26.0+ (Arrow Flight SQL) 方言。Dremio 26.0+ (Arrow Flight SQL) 使用捆绑的 Apache Arrow Flight SQL JDBC 驱动程序，因此你无需安装未打包的自定义 JDBC 驱动程序 JAR 文件。有关更多信息，请参阅 Dremio 文档页面。

功能

“AI 辅助快速入门”功能（在新版探索体验中称为“入门问题”）现已正式发布。

功能

新的“诊断与修复”工具在你的个人开发环境或共享生产环境中，通过八项诊断测试检查来评估你的 LookML 项目仓库。当发现问题时，Looker 可以自动执行修复（例如删除过时的锁文件、修复文件权限或修复损坏的对象索引），或在专用恢复分支上重建受损仓库的同时保护未提交的更改。

功能

Looker 持续集成 (CI) 现在包含 样式验证器，它会在你的 LookML 项目中强制执行 LookML 编码标准、命名约定和结构最佳实践。你可以使用默认的内置规则集运行样式验证器，或通过向项目仓库添加 lkmlstyle.yaml 配置文件来自定义规则严重级别、文件排除、路径覆盖和自定义规则。

功能

现已在 预览版 中提供，对话式分析 agentic 工作流支持定时 agentic 工作流，此外还支持 触发式 agentic 工作流。你可以使用定时 agentic 工作流，通过自然语言安排 AI 生成的洞察摘要、数据表、可视化和 PDF 报告定期投递到电子邮件或 Slack。收件人可以在工作流通知中选择 调查，与数据代理开启私密、持久的对话。

用户和管理员可以分别在更新后的 管理工作流用户页面和 管理工作流管理员页面上管理工作流，并且 Looker 管理员可以在新的 工作流执行管理员页面上监控定时工作流运行并排查错误。

在 Looker 26.14 之前的版本中创建的工作流会显示在 旧版工作流 标签页上，并且必须重新创建。

功能

现已在预览版中提供，Looker 数据应用是由本地 AI 编码代理（例如 Gemini CLI、Claude Code 或 Cursor）根据自然语言提示构建的自由格式画布仪表板。数据应用为你提供完整的视觉布局控制（包括绝对定位、重叠元素和自定义 Web 组件），同时仍受 Looker 受治理的 LookML 语义层和用户权限约束。

变更

在对话式分析中，默认的 问题模式 现为 快速，而非 思考。快速模式旨在快速作答，它会将你的查询直接映射到底层 LookML 定义，而不生成推理步骤。当你询问关于 思考模式的复杂、多步骤分析问题时，你仍然可以从问题模式下拉菜单中选择“思考”模式，以针对 探索或 仪表板 提问。

变更

“现代用户界面”预览功能开关现在默认为 开启。

变更

“现代可视化主题”现在支持地图图表（静态地图点和区域）、词云图表和环形多值图。虽然此前已记录了对环形多值图的支持，但现已在此版本中正式提供。这些新增内容扩展了现代主题可用的可视化选项范围。

Looker（Google Cloud 核心）和 Looker（原始）变更

功能

Looker 现在支持连接到 ClickHouse 26+ 方言。ClickHouse 26+ 使用现代化的 JDBC 驱动程序，并引入了对 对称聚合 的支持。有关更多信息，请参阅 ClickHouse 文档页面。
events.reason: Looker 是主流 BI/语义层平台，本次更新涉及 Dremio 接入、LookML 项目诊断与 CI 规范、以及可调度的对话式分析工作流，直接影响数据团队的平台维护与 AI 分析交付方式。

events.zh_title: Anthropic发布Claude Cowork企业部署指南
events.zh_summary: Anthropic发布新指南，介绍如何用Claude Cowork在企业中部署代理式AI。Claude Cowork将Claude Code的代理能力带至桌面端，支持本地文件、Slack、Google Drive等集成，并可结合Claude for Excel和PowerPoint处理跨表格和幻灯片的流程。指南包括五级成熟度模型、试点评估方法、六个月的推广路线图，以及Anthropic财务、法务、销售和产品团队的实际用例。
events.full_zh:
就在几年前，在工作中使用AI意味着面对聊天窗口：提问，得到回答。2025年，Claude Code将代理引入命令行，开发者开始将一些最繁琐和耗时的流程委托给代理，从解析数据和现代化遗留系统，到在跨服务代码库中发布功能，同时连接到他们最关键的业务系统。

现在，Claude Cowork将同样的能力带到了公司其他人的桌面上：分析师、律师、客户主管、营销人员等。Claude Cowork在已有的工作场所中工作：本地文件和文件夹、连接的应用程序如Slack和Google Drive，以及浏览器。搭配Claude for Excel和Claude for PowerPoint，它还可以在单个工作流程中跨电子表格和演示文稿传递上下文。通过插件、技能和命令，Claude变得更加强大和可定制，以适应您的工作环境。

为了帮助团队充分利用Claude Cowork，我们编制了一份指南，讲解如何跨业务职能部署它，包括从哪里开始、如何构建试点、常见用例以及推动大规模采用的最佳实践。虽然许多示例来自Anthropic自己的团队和客户，包括Thomson Reuters、Zapier和Jamf，但这些模式和经验教训普遍适用于各个行业和公司。

在指南中，我们分享了：

一个五级成熟度模型，用于Claude Cowork的采用，从聊天问答到部门级插件如何选择第一个用例并构建试点评估一个六个月的路线图，从冠军团队到组织范围部署Anthropic的财务、法律、销售和产品团队如何在生产中使用Cowork来自Thomson Reuters、Zapier和Jamf的客户案例

events.zh_title: 领先零售商如何将AI试点扩展为企业级转型
events.zh_summary: 多数企业AI计划起步强劲但停滞迅速，本文基于对零售组织的研究，揭示了领先者与落后者的差别。报告指出三步骤区分AI领导者，来自与可见ROI组织的合作。零售商面临利润薄、客户期望高、自动化压力与服务质量平衡等挑战，PwC报告88%高管计划增加AI投资。Shopify部署Claude驱动Sidekick，将自然语言请求转为ShopifyQL查询；L'Oréal构建以Claude为核心的多Agent系统，为150国44,000员工提供洞察和可视化。
events.full_zh:
大多数企业AI计划起步强劲但迅速停滞。过去一年里，我们与处于不同阶段的零售组织合作，有些陷入试点困境，有些则已将AI扩展到数千名员工。

我们的新指南基于与实现可衡量ROI的组织的合作，确定了将AI领先者与落后者区分开来的三个步骤。

我们的观察

零售商面临熟悉的压力：利润微薄，客户期望不断上升，自动化的压力直接与保持服务质量的需求冲突。普华永道报告称，88%的高管计划今年增加AI投资。

但投资本身不是瓶颈。技术栈在电子商务、POS、库存和CRM系统之间碎片化，这些系统并非为协同工作而设计。季节性需求周期使ROI难以建模。既了解零售运营又了解AI能力的团队很难找到，更难留住。

取得进展的组织已不再将这些视为等待的理由。

实际案例

领先的组织都从特定的运营问题开始，在数周内证明价值，然后从那里扩展。以 Shopify为例，他们部署了Claude为Sidekick提供支持，这是一个AI助手，将复杂的商家请求转化为可操作的见解。当商家用自然语言提问时，Claude将其转化为以前需要技术专长的ShopifyQL查询。

L'Oréal构建了一个以Claude为核心的多Agent系统，协调15多个专业Agent协作，将用户问题转化为见解和可视化，服务于150个国家的44,000名员工。

Lotte Homeshopping部署了一个AI助手，为合作伙伴供应商提供全天候支持，处理QA查询，验证文档，并指导合作伙伴满足法规要求。

前进之路

对于规划2026年优先事项的组织，指南涵盖了三个关键步骤：通过利益相关者对齐和治理奠定基础，启动精心选择的试点项目（从低风险应用开始），并扩展有效方案，同时建设组织能力。

阅读完整的零售企业AI转型指南 此处。

events.zh_title: TiDB Cloud BYOC AWS公测：托管分布式SQL进自有账号
events.zh_summary: TiDB Cloud BYOC 在 AWS 上开启公测，将 TiDB 数据平面运行在客户自有 AWS 账号中，由 PingCAP 托管控制平面负责部署和生命周期运维。该模式让客户控制云环境、网络策略、IAM 权限和加密密钥，并通过限定权限、数据加密和操作审计保障访问安全。BYOC 基于 TiDB X 提供弹性扩缩容、工作负载隔离和原生备份恢复，资源通过客户 AWS 账号计费，可叠加符合条件的 AWS 折扣。客户还可申请偏好 AWS Region，可用性取决于实例类型和可用区要求。
events.full_zh:
Key Takeaways

Run your TiDB data plane in your own AWS account. TiDB Cloud BYOC handles deployment and ongoing operations.Keep control of access. TiDB Cloud uses scoped permissions, data is encrypted, and every operational session is audited.Scale on TiDB X. BYOC adds elastic scaling, workload isolation, and efficient native backup and recovery.Apply your existing AWS discounts to eligible infrastructure, because BYOC resources bill through your AWS account.Request your preferred AWS Region. Availability depends on instance types and Availability Zone requirements.

Teams running distributed SQL in production face a trade-off. A managed service removes the work of upgrades, scaling, and backups, and it moves the database into the vendor’s cloud account. Self-managing TiDB keeps the database in your account and leaves every upgrade, backup, and incident to your team.

Today, we are announcing the public preview of TiDB Cloud BYOC (Bring Your Own Cloud) on AWS. TiDB Cloud BYOC runs managed distributed SQL inside your AWS account, and TiDB Cloud handles deployment and ongoing database operations. BYOC is one of several TiDB Cloud updates announced at SCaiLE 2026.

The split is simple. Your organization controls the cloud environment and the data boundary. TiDB Cloud manages the database lifecycle through operational access you authorize.

What Is TiDB Cloud BYOC?

TiDB Cloud BYOC is a deployment option that separates database management from workload execution. The data plane runs in your AWS account. The control plane, managed by PingCAP, runs orchestration and lifecycle management through TiDB Cloud.

The data plane includes database compute, storage, and networking. Your organization controls the cloud account, network policies, IAM permissions, and encryption keys.

The control plane handles deployment and lifecycle operations. Applications connect to the database’s SQL endpoint for reads and writes, and the control plane never sits in that application traffic path.

Figure: The TiDB Cloud BYOC data plane runs in your AWS account. The TiDB Cloud control plane performs authorized deployment and lifecycle operations.

BYOC brings TiDB’s MySQL compatibility, distributed ACID transactions, and horizontal scalability into your environment. Applications grow without application-level sharding. Built on TiDB X, BYOC pairs these database capabilities with cloud-native elasticity and resource efficiency.

Why Do Teams Choose TiDB Cloud BYOC Over Self-Managed TiDB?

Teams choose BYOC when policy requires production data in their own cloud account and they do not want to staff database operations. Their security policies govern network boundaries, access permissions, encryption keys, and data placement. Their cloud agreements shape how infrastructure is purchased and paid for.

Self-managed TiDB meets these requirements. It also hands the team upgrades, scaling, backups, monitoring, and incident response. That workload grows with every terabyte and every new service on the cluster.

TiDB Cloud BYOC removes that trade-off. Teams keep control of their cloud account and data boundary, keep using eligible AWS discounts, and let TiDB Cloud run the database lifecycle. Several pilot customers already use BYOC ahead of public preview.

For background on the model itself, see bring your own cloud explained.

What Do You Get with TiDB Cloud BYOC?

TiDB Cloud BYOC gives you control over your AWS environment and fully managed database operations. The four areas below cover data placement, access, operations, and cost.

Your Data and Infrastructure Stay in Your AWS Account

Database compute, storage, and networking run in your AWS account. You apply your existing policies for VPCs, IAM, encryption keys, and cloud governance. Database deployment then follows the same security and data residency rules as the rest of your stack.

Governed Access and Built-In Security

TiDB Cloud performs management operations with scoped permissions that follow the principle of least privilege. PingCAP personnel need your authorization to access the environment for troubleshooting and support, and you can revoke it. Every such session is authenticated, and connections, commands, and data access are fully audited.

Encryption protects data in transit, at rest, and in backups. Customer-managed encryption keys are available in supported configurations.

Managed Operations on TiDB X

TiDB Cloud handles deployment, monitoring, scaling, backups, upgrades, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management.

TiDB X adds three operational gains:

Auto-scaling. Compute capacity adjusts as demand changes.Workload isolation. Dedicated elastic compute runs index creation and large data imports apart from online traffic, which keeps application performance predictable.Efficient backups. Backup tasks use fewer compute resources, which lowers the cost of routine data protection.

Your team handles growth and maintains the database with less operational effort.

More Value from Your AWS Investment

Infrastructure costs appear directly in your AWS account, so your team tracks them in existing billing and cost management tools. Eligible enterprise discounts, Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, and other committed-use benefits may apply to covered resources under your AWS agreements.

BYOC deploys on request in your preferred AWS Region. Feasibility depends on instance type availability and Availability Zone requirements. You place the database next to your applications and inside your data residency boundary.

Who Is TiDB Cloud BYOC For?

TiDB Cloud BYOC fits organizations that want managed database operations while production data and infrastructure stay in their own AWS accounts. Four profiles benefit most:

Large-scale TiDB users. Teams that want to cut operational effort and improve infrastructure efficiency as data volumes grow.Organizations with strict data-control requirements. Teams with rules on cloud-account ownership, network boundaries, IAM, or encryption keys.Enterprises with established AWS governance and commercial agreements. Teams that need the database to fit existing security, procurement, and cost management processes.Applications with variable demand. Workloads that need elastic capacity for traffic spikes, seasonal peaks, and growth.

How Is TiDB Cloud BYOC Priced?

TiDB Cloud BYOC pricing has three components. You pay AWS for infrastructure and PingCAP for the managed service and support.

Total BYOC cost = AWS infrastructure cost + PingCAP BYOC service fee + PingCAP support fee

AWS infrastructure. You pay AWS directly for EC2, EBS, S3, networking, and other resources. Eligible discounts apply under your AWS agreements.BYOC service fee. PingCAP charges by provisioned vCPU capacity, metered per minute and billed hourly. Rates are the same across AWS Regions.Support fee. BYOC requires the Enterprise support plan or higher. The fee depends on your plan.

Separate line items let your team evaluate infrastructure consumption and the managed service independently. Contact the PingCAP team for a quote based on your capacity and support requirements.

How to Join the TiDB Cloud BYOC Public Preview

Public preview onboarding runs jointly with the PingCAP team. You prepare a dedicated AWS account. Together, you configure networking and DNS, IAM permissions, certificates, secure maintenance access, and observability, then validate the deployment. The TiDB Cloud BYOC documentation walks through each phase.

Run TiDB Cloud BYOC in your own AWS account. Share your workload, preferred AWS Region, and security requirements, and the PingCAP team will scope a public preview deployment with you. Talk to the TiDB Cloud BYOC team →

events.zh_summary: PingCAP 在 SCaiLE 2026 宣布 TiDB Cloud 多项更新：TiDB Cloud Premium 计划正式可用，客户可用时间为 2026 年 11 月；BYOC 和 TiDB Cloud Filesystem 进入公开预览，前者支持在自有云账户中托管 TiDB Cloud，后者为 AI agent 提供持久工作区。TiDB Cloud Starter 上的 PostgreSQL 支持向所有人开放公开预览，无资格限制；PingCAP 计划在 2026 年底开源 TiDB Cloud 背后架构 TiDB X 的核心代码。文中还提到 Atlassian Forge SQL 运行超过 750 个 PostgreSQL 集群，以及过去六个月 AI agent 在 TiDB Cloud Starter 上创建近 300 万个数据库实例。
events.full_zh:
Key Takeaways

TiDB Cloud Premium is announced for general availability, with customer availability in November 2026.BYOC and TiDB Cloud Filesystem enter public preview: managed TiDB Cloud in your own cloud account, and a persistent workspace for AI agents.PostgreSQL support on TiDB Cloud Starter opens in public preview to anyone, with no eligibility gate.PingCAP plans to open source the core code of TiDB X, the architecture behind TiDB Cloud, by the end of 2026.

Nobody approves a project called “add complexity.” It builds up one shard, one region, and one compliance requirement at a time, until a single database has turned into a fleet and the team running it has grown to match. Atlassian reached that point with Forge SQL, its hosted relational database service for developers, which ran on more than 750 PostgreSQL clusters. What’s new in TiDB Cloud this product release cycle solves this problem.

AI agents compress that timeline from years to months. In the past six months, agents created nearly three million database instances on TiDB Cloud Starter, the entry-level TiDB Cloud plan. The sprawl is familiar; the speed is new. Agentic applications also add a requirement most databases weren’t designed for: preserving an agent’s work so the next session can pick up where the last one stopped.

Enterprise applications and AI applications are converging on the same database requirements from opposite directions. Running both on one operational data foundation avoids adding a second database, duplicating skills, and multiplying the infrastructure and processes it takes to operate them.

Today at SCaiLE 2026, we’re announcing TiDB Cloud updates for both sides of that problem: the planned general availability of TiDB Cloud Premium, public previews of Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC) and TiDB Cloud Filesystem, a public preview of PostgreSQL support on TiDB Cloud Starter, and a plan to open source the core code of TiDB X by the end of 2026. This post covers what each release includes, where it stands today, and how to decide which option fits your workload.

What’s New in TiDB Cloud at a Glance

TiDB Cloud adds one plan headed to general availability, three public previews, and an open-source commitment. Release stage matters when you plan a rollout, so the table below lists each announcement with its current status.

AnnouncementRelease StageWhat It’s ForTiDB Cloud PremiumGA announced; available to customers in November 2026Business-critical applications that need isolated resources, automatic scaling, private connectivity, and customer-managed encryption keysTiDB Cloud EssentialPublic previewGrowing production applications that need control over provisioned compute capacityBYOCPublic preview, available nowOrganizations that want TiDB Cloud’s managed operations with data in their own cloud accountTiDB Cloud FilesystemPublic preview, available nowA persistent workspace that lets AI agents keep code, files, and results across sandboxes and sessionsPostgreSQL support on TiDB Cloud StarterPublic preview, open signupPostgreSQL developers who want to build on TiDB with familiar toolsTiDB X core codeOpen-source release planned by end of 2026Inspecting and adapting the architecture behind TiDB Cloud

TiDB Cloud Starter remains generally available and is the entry point for the PostgreSQL preview. TiDB Cloud Dedicated remains available for teams that need broader cloud and regional coverage or configurable clusters. Starter, Essential, and Premium all run on TiDB X, the architecture that now powers TiDB Cloud.

Why Enterprise and AI Applications Need One Data Foundation

Established companies are adding AI and agentic capabilities to applications that already carry compliance requirements, established tooling, and years of operational history. They can’t discard what works to adopt what comes next. TiDB’s MySQL compatibility lets many existing applications move onto TiDB with minimal code changes. At Pinterest, adopting TiDB simplified the data infrastructure, enabled the retirement of several in-house systems, and reduced maintenance overhead, with infrastructure cost savings of around 50%.

Agent-native companies start from the other end. They create infrastructure at machine speed, then pick up conventional transactional requirements, such as user data, billing, reliability, and persistent state, as experiments turn into products. Manus has scaled to more than 1.5 million TiDB Cloud clusters to support the applications its agents create.

One side needs to become more agentic without building a parallel data stack. The other needs to become a durable business without rebuilding its data layer. Each of today’s announcements serves one or both of those paths.

Choosing How You Run TiDB Cloud: Starter, Essential, Premium, and BYOC

TiDB Cloud offers several operating models on a shared data foundation, so you can choose the capacity, isolation, and data control your workload needs. Starter covers on-demand development, Essential adds control over provisioned capacity, Premium isolates business-critical workloads, and BYOC keeps your data in your own cloud account.

TiDB Cloud Premium: Isolation for Business-Critical Workloads

TiDB Cloud Premium is announced for general availability today, with customer availability in November 2026. It’s built for business-critical applications that need elastic compute on resources isolated from other tenants. Three-zone availability and a 99.99% monthly uptime SLA help teams meet application reliability requirements as workloads grow. Premium also supports private connectivity.

TiDB Cloud Essential: Provisioned Capacity for Growing Applications

TiDB Cloud Essential, in public preview, is for growing production applications that need predictable performance and cost. You set a compute limit and TiDB Cloud scales automatically with demand, which reduces the need for manual capacity adjustments.

BYOC: Managed TiDB Cloud in Your Own Cloud Account

For applications with security, data residency, or governance requirements that call for customer-controlled infrastructure, TiDB Cloud BYOC (Bring Your Own Cloud) keeps the database in your cloud account while PingCAP manages database operations and routine maintenance. You retain control of the cloud account and application access. BYOC is in public preview and designed for existing TiDB Self-Managed customers who want to reduce operational work. Manus has expanded its use of BYOC alongside TiDB Cloud Filesystem. The BYOC onboarding guide walks through getting started.

Consolidation at Scale: Atlassian

Atlassian shows what running on one foundation looks like at enterprise scale. For Forge SQL, Atlassian consolidated more than 750 PostgreSQL clusters into 16 TiDB clusters that support more than three million tables. Vinod Kumar, VP and Head of Engineering at Atlassian, covers how Atlassian runs demanding enterprise workloads on a single data foundation in his SCaiLE 2026 keynote. For more on this pattern, see how TiDB supports multi-tenant SaaS platforms.

Which TiDB Cloud Option Fits Your Workload

Use the table below to match a requirement to a starting point. Plan details and pricing live on our pricing page.

If You Need…Start With…On-demand compute that scales to zero when idle, with a free usage quota, for building and prototypingTiDB Cloud Starter (generally available)To build on TiDB with PostgreSQL skills, drivers, and toolsPostgreSQL on TiDB Cloud Starter (public preview)Control over provisioned compute capacity for a growing production applicationTiDB Cloud Essential (public preview)Isolated resources, private connectivity, and customer-managed encryption keys for business-critical workloadsTiDB Cloud Premium (available November 2026)Managed database operations with data in your own cloud accountBYOC (public preview)Broader cloud and regional coverage or configurable clusters todayTiDB Cloud DedicatedTo deploy, configure, and operate TiDB on infrastructure you manage, including on premises or air-gappedTiDB Self-Managed

PostgreSQL Support on TiDB Cloud Starter

PostgreSQL support on TiDB Cloud Starter enters public preview today, with open signup and no eligibility gate. Anyone can sign up, create a PostgreSQL-compatible instance on Starter, and use it within the documented preview limits.

Until now, PostgreSQL has marked a boundary on where developers could start with TiDB. Teams with PostgreSQL skills, drivers, and tooling had to work in the MySQL ecosystem to use TiDB. This preview opens TiDB Cloud to teams building in the PostgreSQL ecosystem. PostgreSQL-compatible Starter supports SQL embedding generation, vector search, and full-text search, so developers can retrieve relevant context for agentic applications using familiar PostgreSQL clients and drivers.

PostgreSQL compatibility is currently available in public preview on Starter for development and evaluation, subject to documented limits. The preview has no production SLA and does not extend PostgreSQL compatibility to Premium or BYOC. Try PostgresSQL-compatible Starter on TiDB Cloud⁠.

TiDB Cloud Filesystem: A Persistent Workspace for AI Agents

TiDB Cloud Filesystem, now in public preview, gives AI agents a persistent workspace that outlasts the sandbox they run in. When an agent starts a new session in a new sandbox, its saved code, context files, and results are still there, so it continues from prior work instead of rebuilding.

Agents are temporary. Their work isn’t. A coding agent clones a repository, installs dependencies, runs tests, and writes patches, and all of it disappears when the sandbox ends. Rather than adding a separate file-storage layer beside the database, TiDB Cloud Filesystem persists that work on the same foundation as the rest of your agent data.

The public preview supports:

Git workspace resume. Restore an agent’s saved Git working state in another sandbox instead of starting from a fresh clone.Shared files across workflows. Access the same files from supported sandboxes, local tools, and CI jobs.A coding-agent profile. Keep rebuildable directories such as node_modules local, and persist test results, failure logs, and patches.Search by name, content, or meaning. Enable embeddings with a supported provider and your own API key to search file contents semantically.Checkpoints and forks. Checkpoint a layer before an experiment, fork from the saved state, or roll back uncommitted changes.

During the preview, FUSE mounts buffer writes locally, so another runtime may not see changes immediately. Sync pending writes before handing off a workspace, since checkpoints include only synced changes.

Moonshot AI, the company behind Kimi, helped shape TiDB Cloud Filesystem and uses it to support coding-agent work across more than one million persistent filesystems. Using TiDB Cloud, Kimi has also reduced its data infrastructure costs by an order of magnitude.

Get started with TiDB Cloud Filesystem, then follow the sandbox handoff example to reuse saved work across sessions.

Open Sourcing the Core of TiDB X

PingCAP plans to open source the core code of TiDB X by the end of 2026. The move extends TiDB’s open-source commitment to its latest architecture, so teams can inspect and adapt the core technology they depend on and keep more control over their long-term data foundation.

“Every team should be able to start small on a data foundation that can grow with its ambitions,” said Max Liu, co-founder and CEO of TiDB. “TiDB has been battle-tested at extraordinary scale by large enterprises and frontier AI pioneers. We’re bringing the capabilities shaped by that experience into a managed cloud platform, so more organizations can scale on the same foundation without having to build the specialized teams and manage the infrastructure complexity behind it.”

Get Started With TiDB Cloud

Whether you start from an established application or an agent-built one, today’s releases let you change how you run TiDB as your requirements grow without changing the database underneath. Starter is the fastest way to see that for yourself, and it’s where both the MySQL-compatible and PostgreSQL preview paths begin.

Create a free TiDB Cloud Starter cluster and connect with the MySQL or PostgreSQL tools you already use.

Frequently Asked Questions

When is TiDB Cloud Premium available?

TiDB Cloud Premium was announced for general availability at SCaiLE 2026 on October 15, 2026, and becomes available to customers in November 2026. It’s built for business-critical applications that need isolated resources, automatic scaling, private connectivity, and customer-managed encryption keys. Teams that need broader cloud and regional coverage today can use TiDB Cloud Dedicated.

Who can use PostgreSQL support on TiDB Cloud Starter?

Anyone. The public preview has open signup and no eligibility gate, and usage is subject to the documented preview limits. PostgreSQL support is in public preview, not general availability, so review the preview limitations before running production workloads.

What is BYOC in TiDB Cloud?

BYOC (Bring Your Own Cloud) is a TiDB Cloud deployment option that keeps your data in your own cloud environment while TiDB Cloud manages database operations. You manage your data and control how applications access it. BYOC is in public preview.

What is TiDB Cloud Filesystem?

TiDB Cloud Filesystem is a persistent workspace for AI agents. It keeps code, files, saved Git state, and results available across sandboxes and sessions, so the next agent can continue where the last one stopped. It’s in public preview, and preview pricing and usage limits apply.

What’s the difference between TiDB Cloud Essential and Premium?

Essential, in public preview, gives growing applications control over provisioned compute: you set a compute limit and TiDB Cloud scales automatically with demand. Premium, available in November 2026, adds compute on resources isolated from other tenants, private connectivity, and customer-managed encryption keys for business-critical workloads that need predictable performance during bursts.

What is TiDB X?

TiDB X is the architecture that powers TiDB Cloud Starter, Essential, and Premium. PingCAP plans to open source the core code of TiDB X by the end of 2026.

events.zh_title: Snowflake无人值守Agent：六种失败模式与护栏
events.zh_summary: Snowflake官方博客介绍如何用CoCo automations在Snowflake内调度无人值守的编码Agent，让它自动跟进PR、CI失败和评审评论。作者采用按仓库/PR维护状态表、拆分监控与评审任务、独立watchdog，以及把权限校验放在Agent之外等架构。文章总结六种误导性失败模式，并解释每道护栏的作用。CoCo automations目前处于public preview，功能可能变化。
events.full_zh:
在 Snowflake 中调度一个无人值守的编码 agent 现在只需几个 CLI 标志。让它保持诚实才是真正的工作。下面是我们最终采用的整体架构，以及六种失败模式——正是它们让我们明白了每道护栏为何存在。

注意：CoCo 自动化处于公开预览阶段。 以下内容均描述预览功能，可能会发生变化。

你将了解到：

无需单独的运行器即可运行定时 agent拆分工作并添加独立的看门狗把权限检查放在 agent 之外识别六种误导性失败以及该检查什么

让拉取请求无人值守地持续推进

我们希望 agent 能察觉到某个分支落后于 main、CI 失败、或有评审意见无人回应——而无需有人先打开聊天。

这意味着要调度运行、记住之前的工作，并限制 agent 能改动什么。我们使用 CoCo 自动化，以免维护单独的运行器或容器。搭建过程很直接。搞清楚定时工作是否真的完成了，则要费更多功夫。

整体结构

四个术语，因为后文措辞很重要：

自动化：一次循环的、无人值守的 agent 运行。存储为 AGENT TASK，定时调度，在 Snowflake 管理的沙箱中执行。agent 循环本身不需要仓库。运行手册：提示词。一个 markdown 文件，描述 agent 每次运行应做什么，在创建自动化时随其一同保存。MCP 服务器：agent 如何触达外部世界，包括源代码控制和聊天。显式挂接到自动化上。状态表：一张普通的 Snowflake 表，以仓库和拉取请求为键，保存 agent 在两次运行之间绝不能忘记的一切。

Snowflake 负责运行时，因此我们不需要维护单独的服务器或运行器。自动化以其创建者的身份运行，凭证存储在 Snowflake 密钥对象中，而不是 CI 中。

我们把工作拆分到多个独立的自动化中，而不是一个大自动化，事实证明这比预期更重要：

一个监控器每小时运行一次。它保持打开的拉取请求可合并，在分支落后时将基础分支合并进来，并就任何非例行的维护事务通知作者。一个评审引擎每小时运行一次，消费一个工作队列，发布标准评审，并回应来自人类和机器人的未解决评论。一个看门狗按自己的计划运行，并且可以关闭评审引擎。一个摘要每个工作日早晨运行一次，报告发生了什么。

拆分它们意味着看门狗不是由它所监督的对象实现的，而且嘈杂组件中的故障不会拖垮那个向你报告故障的组件。写下来这听起来显而易见。在构建时却并不明显。

此命令创建监控器。自动化处于公开预览阶段，因此复制之前请对照当前文档检查标志。

cortex automation create \
  --name PR_MONITOR \
  --connection my_connection \
  --schedule "hourly" \
  --timezone America/New_York \
  --workspace MY_DB.MY_SCHEMA.AGENT_WS \
  --mcp MY_DB.MY_SCHEMA.MCP_STATE_WRITES \
  --mcp MY_DB.MY_SCHEMA.MCP_GITHUB \
  --mcp MY_DB.MY_SCHEMA.MCP_JIRA \
  --mcp MY_DB.MY_SCHEMA.MCP_NOTIFY \
  --prompt-file ./monitor_runbook.md

自动化以创建用户的默认角色和默认次要角色运行，而不是您创建它们时处于活动状态的角色。如果您想要只读上限，请使用受限会话范围设置一个。我们通过一个以 MCP 工具形式暴露的存储过程写入状态，因此 agent 只能以我们定义的方式更改状态。

agent 的记忆不是向量存储，也不是仓库中的文件。它是一张表，每个拉取请求一行，当有异常时你可以查询它。

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE PR_STATE (
  REPO VARCHAR NOT NULL,
  PR_NUMBER NUMBER NOT NULL,
  HEAD_SHA VARCHAR,
  CI_SHA VARCHAR,
  CI_STATE VARCHAR,
  REVIEW_DIFF_HASH VARCHAR,
  LAST_CHECKED_AT TIMESTAMP_NTZ,
  PRIMARY KEY (REPO, PR_NUMBER)
);

我们跟踪 CI 检查了哪个提交、我们已经评审了哪些更改，以及监控器上次检查该 PR 的时间。

护栏

护栏一：在 agent 之外授权更改agent 提出修复方案；一个确定性的辅助程序检查它是否可以推送这些修复。这些检查位于 agent 循环之外的代码中。每个贡献者被设置为一种模式，从仅评审到自动修复，该模式决定修复是否需要人工批准。

在批准模式下，人类必须回复一个由辅助程序生成的、一次性的令牌，修复才会被推送。辅助程序检查该令牌。agent 的说明不算作批准。

护栏二：给看门狗自己的职责 agent 可能会陷入修复自己修复的循环。我们运行一个独立的看门狗，检查仓库提交历史中的失控循环，并可以禁用评审引擎。

看门狗按自己的计划运行，不依赖引擎对发生情况的描述。如果引擎在循环，我们希望由该引擎之外的某个对象来判断一切是否正常。

护栏三：知道你的测试衡量的是什么我们从影子模式开始：引擎提出修复方案但不推送任何内容。在转向批准令牌之前，我们对这些方案进行了评分。

影子模式测试了修复质量，但无法表明某个修复是否会无休止地触发另一个修复。没有推送，就没有第二轮。批准令牌让我们能够在有人参与的情况下观察真实的推送和随后的 CI 周期。

失败模式

我当时在度假，用手机检查一切，并用 CoCo 试着在雨林徒步 🌲 和游客购物狂欢 🛍️ 之间修复错误。真希望我在亲身体验这些之前就知道它们。

一个并不是超时的超时 工作没有完成，但每次运行都报告成功。我以为可能是运行时间太长并触发了超时。问题出在超时设置本身。该工具最多接受 600 秒，而我配置的值超过了这个数。每次调用都立即失败，甚至在存储过程开始之前就失败了。把设置降到 600 就解决了。然后我在第二个工具中犯了同样的错误，尽管我已经记下了第一个工具的教训。我怎么又这样了？！我计划添加一个测试，在工具发布前拒绝无效的超时。我还没有构建它。与此同时，我愿意相信我不会第三次犯同样的错误。

agent 误诊了失败agent 把失败的调用描述为“查询超时”，这让我去寻找容量问题。该调用实际上在执行之前就被拒绝了。我们需要检查底层错误，而不是依赖 agent 的解释。

毫无意义的成功一次运行可以在什么工作都没做的情况下报告成功。任务完成了；代理的工具全部失败；没有任何报错。我们的报告会在绿灯下连续数周失去踪影。如果你唯一的健康信号是“计划运行是否完成”，那你就没有健康信号。要对输出做出断言：是否有一行数据落地，是否有一条消息发布，产物是否比本次运行更新。

工具的配置会覆盖你的运行手册每个工具都带有自己的计算配置。运行手册中的 USE WAREHOUSE 语句无法保护一个被固定到另一个已饱和仓库的工具。我们的情况正是如此，所有告警都在队列中滞留了四天，而运行手册看起来却完全正确。检查每个工具自身的仓库设置，而不只是运行手册。

命名一个工具并不等同于绑定到它一个引用了服务器的运行手册只能证明作者意图建立绑定。在我们的运行中，describe 命令没有列出已附加的服务器，因此有一个月时间，我们的摘要被绑定到了一个不包含运行手册所调用工具的服务器上。读取实际对象定义。将其与你原本的意图进行差异比对。

而代价最大的一个：长期的误报掩盖了真实的故障我们有一个质量门，其阈值来自其自身历史输出的中位数。它连续十二天每天触发。团队学会了忽略它。在其之下，一个真正的上游中断在期间开始，并在余下的时间里未被察觉，因为本应告知我们的渠道早已充满了我们训练自己去跳过的噪音。

在发布告警阈值之前，用历史数据回放它，并检查它本会触发的频率。

回顾

一个自动化组合了计划提示、附加的 MCP 工具和一个状态表。代理循环本身不需要仓库。拆分工作。看门狗不能是它自己所监视的东西。代理提出建议；确定性代码负责授权。了解你的验证在衡量什么。影子模式测试的是修复质量，而不是循环深度。一次绿色的运行证明不了任何东西。要对输出做出断言。嘈杂的告警比没有告警更糟。

作者：Kat Prince-Sayward，GTM 分析负责人。

你的代理整夜运行了。以下是它做错的地方。最初发表于Snowflake Builders Blog：数据工程师、应用开发者、AI 与数据科学于 Medium，人们通过高亮并回应这个故事在那里继续对话。

events.zh_title: 不牺牲数据完整性的分析实践
events.zh_summary: Amplitude认为分析工具不应因技术便利而牺牲数据完整性。他们指出用户不信任数据是影响分析决策的主要原因，而过去分析系统常常为易用性牺牲准确性。文章分享了为确保数据完整性所解决的4个技术问题。
events.full_zh:
在Amplitude，我们首先相信提供最好的产品分析。我们为用户找到合适的解决方案，然后想办法在工程方面实现它。这与其他分析服务或内部分析团队不同，后者为了技术上的便利而在数据完整性上做出妥协。

但人们不使用分析来做决策的首要原因之一是他们不信任数据。而且有充分的理由——我们这些构建分析的人历来在系统更容易构建时选择牺牲准确性。然而，我们认为分析的角色正在改变，分析可以而且需要做得更好。

2026年人力资源中的人工智能状况

2026年3月31日

AI聊天机器人：程序员在办公室内使用人工智能进行软件开发。虚拟聊天机器人技术趋势

人工智能现在以重要方式塑造组织战略，为人力资源领导者创造机会，提升人才管理并促进长期增长。然而，真正的影响来自于将人工智能与只有人类智能才能提供的经验、判断和同理心相结合。人力资源领导力在利用技术进步和人类理解方面至关重要——确保新工具服务于人、强化核心价值观并加强文化。这种平衡的方法使组织能够提高运营效率、保持合规性，并激发持续创新以支持持久成功。

SHRM思想领导力开展这项研究，以阐明人力资源专业人士如何应对这一关键转型，审视AI在工作场所的承诺和复杂性。基于1,908名人力资源专业人士的见解，该报告揭示了哪些人力资源职能受AI影响最大，确定了采用AI的持续挑战，并详细说明了组织为制定政策和确保合规所采取的步骤。

作为这些发现补充，《人力资源中的AI白皮书》就负责任的AI采用如何将立法框架与组织需求联系起来提供了全面视角，使人力资源领导者能够自信地应对AI驱动的转型。这些发现提供了可操作的指导，使您在引导组织和员工前进时能够做出明智的战略决策。
